headline: Pew finds job fears outweigh hopes in 34 of 37 countries
body: Worry about work led the day. A Pew Research Center survey found majorities or pluralities in 34 of 37 countries expect AI to eliminate more jobs than it creates, with the US share up seven points in two years. That feeds Tech Backlash, lifting Reversion, and dents Shared Prosperity, which weighs on Egalitarian Utopia. A small 'Stop the AI Race' march in San Francisco added to the backlash. Huawei laid out its 2027 Ascend 960 chip roadmap, a sign of capability spreading to more players, which slightly eases Power Concentration. Horizon Balance held at -7.17.
movers_note: Reversion +0.3 came from the Pew survey (+0.30) and the march (+0.04); 1984 -0.1 and Libertarian Utopia +0.1 tracked Huawei's roadmap (-0.09 and +0.07).
